method: permutation across origins of one feature's columns in the 237-column block design, then the three band detectors are re-predicted, the two archived arm forecasts are re-routed at tau=0.234 and the official MSE is recomputed; ΔMSE vs the submitted routing
note: the arm forecasts are frozen archives, so the permutation measures the routing component only; the scored windows are public, so this is diagnostic and was not used for selection
split_counts: xgboost get_dump over the 400 trees of each of the six archived boosters; design column -> source feature, hourly features summed over their 24 lead copies
